newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yemen Masila term buyers to reject Q4 price offer.
newsitem.headline: Yemen Masila term buyers to reject Q4 price offer.

text.p: Term lifters of Yemen's Masila crude said on Tuesday they would not accept Yemen's proposal to raise fourth-quarter 1996 term prices.
"There is no way we can accept a price higher than third-quarter prices," a term lifter said.
Compared to the initial proposal for the fourth-quarter, Yemen has offered to lower its selling price by five cents to dated Brent minus 25 cents per barrel, traders said.
Term buyers have asked for fourth-quarter prices to be cut to dated Brent minus 55 to minus 70 cents, compared to dated Brent minus 45 cents during the third-quarter.
In Asia, Brent-linked crudes lose price competitiveness when the price of Brent rises in comparison to Dubai, which is regarded as a benchmark.
